title: Chaos Random Items
description: A fun server plugin that automatically gives random items to players on a highly configurable timer.
body:
# Chaos Random Items

A lightweight and fun server plugin perfect for challenges, streams, or survival with friends! It automatically gives an absolutely random item from Minecraft to online players on a configurable timer.

### ✨ Features:
* **Fully Automated** – No complex setups required.
* **Actionbar Timer** – All players see a clean countdown above their hotbar.
* **Anti-Lag System** – If an inventory is full, items drop naturally on the ground.
* **Multilang Config** – Easily switch or customize all messages in `config.yml` (English and Russian included out of the box).
* **Target Selectors** – Give items to EVERYONE or to a RANDOM lucky player.

### 🎮 Commands:
* `/chaos on` — Activate the item chaos.
* `/chaos off` — Pause the challenge.

### 🔒 Permissions:
* `randomitems.admin` — Required to use the `/chaos` command.
